Upstream requirements:

If a

read operation is requested, the DM shall retrieve the data for the
dataRecord of the
DDDID
by using the configuration of the contained
DIDs
.
⌋
7.3.2.8.14 Service 0x2E – WriteDataByIdentifier
The processing of a UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E) is described in ISO
14229-1[1], see in particular the evaluation sequence in Figure 21. On processing, the
Diagnostic Server instance
needs to perform various checks.
The following requirements determine the relation between the input data to be
checked and the configuration provided to the
Diagnostic Server instance
via
DEXT parameters.
